items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And another fellow named Mouse Randolph, he was a nice trumpet player, too. Them three always reminded me of one another

ctx.x: And he was with Chick Webb.

Yeah, he was a good trumpet player. That's all I can say. I can't even remember what he looked like, but I remember the name. And then Doc Cheatham...they reminded me of one another, you know. He was a good trumpeter, a clean trumpet player, you know what I mean, like Doc is. And another fellow named Mouse Randolph, he was a nice trumpet player, too. Them three always reminded me of one another -- Doc, Swayzee and Randolph.

I know Cheatham from way back. He come here with a clarinet player, and I don't remember his name... But him and Swayzee was buddies, you know. I think at that time Doc was playing saxophone, too. He used to play saxophone and trumpet. But he stuck with the trumpet. And the other fellow played the saxophone and clarinet. And he was a good clarinetist, he was a good musician, this other fellow. But his head went bad.
